email.body1:
Tiffany, saw Bitsight crossed $200M ARR and topped the latest Forrester Wave.

At that scale, the bottleneck is rarely signal, it is the lag between a signal firing and a GTM rep acting on it. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized, multi-channel outreach with zero human time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Bitsight off your hiring and tech-stack signals. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through how it routes signal to action?
email.body2:
Tiffany, quick follow-up for Bitsight.

Most GTM RevOps teams lose pipeline to slow follow-up and uneven data hygiene, not a shortage of accounts. Our built-in best practices alone tend to lift response rates 50 to 70 percent before anything custom.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three concrete things I would change, and where the measurable lift usually comes from.
email.body3:
Tiffany, last bit of proof for Bitsight.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Bitsight's reply rate likely compares to other cyber and risk vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
